subtle-hover.$description: Hover overlay for transparent (subtle) controls: secondary/ghost button, tab, list item, neutral switch track.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring: neutral high-contrast stroke (black in Light, white in Dark), same for all controls and types incl. Primary/Danger — like Fluent colorStrokeFocus2. Fields use border/strong instead.

display.$description: Marketing / hero headline, desktop only. ≈ Material 3 Display, Tailwind text-6xl. Tokens: typography/heading/3xl/*. Code: var(--ot-typography-heading-3xl)-*

h1.$description: Page title. ≈ Fluent 2 Large Title, shadcn h1. Tokens: typography/heading/2xl/*. Code: var(--ot-typography-heading-2xl-*)

h2.$description: Section title. = Fluent 2 Title 1. Tokens: typography/heading/xl/*. Code: var(--ot-typography-heading-xl-*)

h3.$description: Sub-section / card title. = Fluent 2 Title 3, shadcn h3. Tokens: typography/heading/lg/*. Code: var(--ot-typography-heading-lg-*)

subtitle-1.$description: Group header, dialog title. = Fluent 2 Subtitle 1. Tokens: typography/heading/md/*. Code: var(--ot-typography-heading-md-*)

subtitle-2.$description: Small header, list group. ≈ Fluent 2 Subtitle 2. Tokens: typography/heading/sm/*. Code: var(--ot-typography-heading-sm-*)

body-1.$description: Default UI text, 14px. = Fluent 2 Body 1, shadcn text-sm. Tokens: typography/body/md/*. Code: var(--ot-typography-body-md-*)

body-2.$description: Long-form / reading text, 16px. = shadcn p. Tokens: typography/body/lg/*. Code: var(--ot-typography-body-lg-*)

caption.$description: Helper, meta, timestamps, 12px. = Fluent 2 Caption 1. Tokens: typography/body/sm/*. Code: var(--ot-typography-body-sm-*)

caption-strong.$description: Chips, badges, small labels, 12px medium. = Fluent 2 Caption 1 Strong. Tokens: typography/label/sm/*. Code: var(--ot-typography-label-sm-*)

label-l.$description: Control text (Button L), 16px medium. Tokens: typography/label/lg/*. Code: var(--ot-typography-label-lg-*)

label-m.$description: Control text (Button M, Tab, Input L label), 14px medium. Tokens: typography/label/md/*. Code: var(--ot-typography-label-md-*)

label-s.$description: Control text (Button S), 12px medium. Tokens: typography/label/sm/*. Code: var(--ot-typography-label-sm)-*

sm.$description: Raised small surfaces: selected segment, switch thumb, card on page. Tokens: elevation/sm/*, color/shadow/key

md.$description: Floating UI: dropdown, menu, popover, tooltip, toast. Tokens: elevation/md/*, color/shadow/key

lg.$description: Modal layer: dialog, drawer, sheet. Tokens: elevation/lg/*, color/shadow/key
